# Commit 10485562e updated FlashInfer from 0.6.6 without fully resolving its
# transitive dependencies, leaving nvidia-cutlass-dsl==4.4.1 in a stale lock.
# The pinned 0.6.12rc1 wheel's Requires-Dist metadata (not an RTP-LLM b12x
# import) requires cuda-tile[tileiras] and nvidia-cutlass-dsl>=4.5.0. TileIRAS
# brings CUDA 13 host compiler packages used by its SM120 DSL path even though
# RTP-LLM runs with the CUDA 12.9 runtime. These pins repair that stale lock;
# they are not an independent B12x dependency upgrade.
# This lock is shared by all CUDA 12.9 x86 devices; keep these requirements and
# their lock changes together. Do not restore 4.4.1 unless FlashInfer is also
# rolled back to a version whose metadata permits it.
cuda-tile[tileiras]==1.3.0
nvidia-cutlass-dsl==4.5.3
